headline: Added an in-game Help page with 80 searchable articles to the settings window.

entries.title: In-game Help page with searchable articles
entries.details: A new Help page in the settings window offers 80 searchable articles about how BetterBags works. Search as you type on the Help page, in settings search, or with /bb help. Articles include links and settings themselves, showing only what applies to your bag design and game version.
